remarks: *Open House Cancelled* Experience city living at its finest in this sun-drenched 2 bedroom, 1 bath condo nestled in the vibrant heart of downtown Stamford. Located on the 8th floor, this bright corner unit boasts an open-concept living and dining space, enhanced by oversized windows and rich cherry wood flooring throughout. The newly refreshed kitchen features brand-new stainless steel appliances, including a gas range and refrigerator, complemented by modern tile backsplash and butcher block countertops. There are two generously sized bedrooms offer ample closet space one with a walk in closet, an updated bathroom and lighted ceiling fans throughout. Spanning 1,069 sq. ft., this unit also includes a private balcony where you can take in stunning sunset views over the city skyline. This secure-entry building has been recently updated with beautifully designed common areas, and offers a range of amenities such as an on-site fitness center, laundry facilities, and a dedicated superintendent. Relax in the professionally landscaped courtyard, complete with a serene fountain in a botanical-inspired setting. With easy access to the train station, I-95, and local shops, restaurants, and parks, this location is a commuter's dream. One reserved indoor garage parking spot (#40) is included, and the HOA fee covers heat, hot water, and cooking gas. Whether you're looking to owner occupy or purchase as an investment, this condo is a fantastic opportunity for all!
